question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **arrive.**

• **Arrive** means reaching a place at the end of a journey or a stage in a journey.

 
 
• **Example - ***we will be in touch with them when the time **arrives**.*
